subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The meals began to make sense.”?
options: A student said, "Food is like a map of life."
One student said his little sister learned to tie her shoes.
A student said, "But we did not control everything."
The student council decided to make a new map.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The meals began to make sense. A student said, 'Food is like a map of life.'」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One student said his little sister learned to tie her shoes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A student said, 'But we did not control everything.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The student council decided to make a new map.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The meals began to make sense. A student said, 'Food is like a map of life.'」，答案為「A student said, 'Food is like a map of life.'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A student said, 'Food is like a map of life.'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
